title: Info ministry says video of Asif comparing Pakistan's progress with India's is fake

article.title: Info ministry says video of Asif comparing Pakistan's progress with India's is fake
article.summary: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting on Monday said that a video of Defence Minister Khawaja Asif comparing Pakistan’s progress with India’s was “fake”, adding that the PML-N leader had not made any such statement. The ministry shared the purported clip of the minister on its X account. The nearly minute-long video appeared to show a clip from a press conference by the minister on a major news channel. In the purported video, the minister called on citizens to review the country’s situation. He went on to say that Pakistan and India had gained independence at the same time, yet the difference in progress between the two was evident. The purported clip showed Asif saying that Balochistan had “slipped from our hands”, the people in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa were facing difficulties and residents of Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) had taken to the streets for their rights. On the other hand, look at India, Asif said in the alleged video, pointing to the country’s progress in technology, infrastructure and the economy. “We have to ask ourselves whether we are a true democracy.
